name: kochbuch-android
description: Capacitor native-shell tooling for Kochbuch's Android app (loads the live https://kochen.steindorff.de/ web app in a WebView and receives images/text shared from other apps, including Chrome). The PHP web app itself (public/, templates/, src/) has no build step and is unaffected by this - this package.json only exists for the android/ Capacitor project alongside it.
